sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:38

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:38:1
items.html: And this is what he says, that the vessels of the NHY of Keter, which clothe in AVI in the phase of the garments of Mochin, were annulled as well; but they are not reckoned as the phase of Keter, since they have already clothed in AVI. And the reason is that this second Rosh [head], which is the Keter of Nekudim, took nothing at all from the phase of the coupling of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] of Nekudim, for it is the phase of the Bina of the Rosh and GAR [first three] from the beginning of its emanation. Rather, only the phase of its NHY, which clothe in AVI and became garments of Mochin for them, and which came at the time of the Gadlut of Nekudim — they alone were annulled, as explained.
